en.title: Search Suggestions
en.description:
You are given distinct product names and a search word. After each character of the search word is typed, output at most 3 lexicographically smallest products among all products matching the current prefix.

This site added the standard input/output protocol; it does not mean the original function-style problem had this protocol.
en.input: The first line contains n m (1 ≤ n,m ≤ 1000); the second line contains n product names without whitespace; the third line contains the search word. Product names and the search word contain only lowercase English letters.
en.output: Output one line for each non-empty prefix of the search word. The line lists at most 3 smallest matching products in lexicographic order; output - if nothing matches.
en.explanation: See the accompanying notes for the problem rules, approach, and proof.
hints: Sort the products first, then search each prefix and collect the first 3 items.
